about: Pose markers for a character that had painted whole-figure poses but no Pose Lab marker file (cast plan, shots/scion2/cast_plan.md). markers: {name: [x, y, weight, source, confidence]} in card px, same names/format as poses/markers.json and the targets[].markers of the other poses/*.json files. NO rig solves yet: run shots/rig/solve.py once the cards are mapped to this key (solve.py target_list keys these cards as club/shared, vintage_party/vintage, young_ghost/ghost->young_poet/child_clothes or poet/black_tshirt or not at all).
method: MoveNet Lightning run by the repo tool (shots/rig/markers.html, movenet-run.js, PoseCore.prefillMarkers; headless Chromium, cpu backend) on a scratch target list built with solve.prepare (bbox, floor, brass brads); every overlay checked by eye; rejected reads re-marked by hand (source "manual", "manual-hidden" for occluded joints).
